## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue or documented rationale.
- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Public API changes include rustdoc examples and follow the SemVer policy.
- [ ] User-facing or architectural changes update docs and the changelog.
- [ ] No secrets, private targets, credentials, or real customer data are included.
- [ ] Security-testing examples use only owned or explicitly authorized targets.
